attributes.action: Consultation on the proposal to enact Doris's law on assisted dying
attributes.additional_details:
It would be a statute bar to any coercion of frail elderly people. It would be a statute bar to any slippery slope from pressurised courts. There would be an End of Life Commission charged with issuing and reviewing guidance as to the clinical pictures that could support applications.

For details, please search on X for #Doris_law
attributes.background: Doris's law would be a tightly regulated system based on a list in regulations of medical conditions permitting eligibility to make applications to the High Court.

rejection.details:
The specific action you are calling for is unclear.  We cannot accept petitions that require access by link to external sites to understand what they are asking for. 

Legalise assisted dying for terminally ill adults: https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/777578
